evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate lets the agent pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for the 20-inch carry-on; the order is the 24-inch model.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One suitcase was ordered and the mandate asks for one.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The $92.95 total is under the $100.00 limit.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the submitted cart total.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the 24-inch suitcase that was ordered.

verdict.reason: The store charged and shipped exactly what the agent submitted, so STORE does not apply. The agent submitted a 24-inch suitcase at step 6 when the mandate approved only the 20-inch model, so the order differs from the mandate in item. The buyer's report about the store sending the wrong size is contradicted by the store record, which shows the 24-inch model was shipped as ordered.
